active.description: Enable or disable audit logging at boot.

log_file.description: Full path to the primary audit log file.

log_format.description: Format of audit logs — 'raw' (no timestamps) or 'inc' (incremental format).

max_log_file.description: Maximum number of audit log files to retain after rotation.

max_log_file_action.description: Action to take when a single log file reaches max_log_file_size — typically 'rotate', 'suspend', 'restart', 'keep_logs'.

space_left.description: Disk space (in MB) remaining before space_left_action is triggered.

space_left_action.description: Action to take when free disk space drops below space_left — 'email', 'syslog', 'suspend', 'single', 'halt', 'none'.

use_syslog.description: Send emergency messages to syslog instead of the audit log.

verbosity.description: Audit daemon verbosity (0 = silent, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose).

priority_boost.description: Priority to boost syslog messages (0 = no boost, higher = higher priority).

flush.description: Flush mode: 'none' (defer writes), 'data' (sync after every record), 'sync' (full sync), 'incremental' (periodic flush).

freq.description: Number of records to buffer before flushing (used only in 'incremental' mode).

max_retries.description: Number of times to retry a write operation on failure.

retry_timeout.description: Seconds to wait between write retries.

log_group.description: Name of the log file group (affects permissions).

remote_log.description: Enable sending audit logs to a remote server via auditd protocol.

remote_address.description: Hostname or IP of the remote audit server (required if remote_log = true).

local_logging.description: Keep local copies of logs even when remote logging is enabled.

queue_len.description: Number of events to buffer in kernel (0 = use kernel default).

admin_space_left.description: Disk space (MB) remaining before admin_space_left_action is triggered.

admin_space_left_action.description: Action when free space drops below admin_space_left — 'email', 'syslog', 'single', 'halt', 'none'.

pause.description: Seconds to pause logging when disk space is critically low (0 = no pause).

resume_after.description: Seconds to wait before resuming logging after a pause.

args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to the auditd binary at startup.

extra_logs.description: List of additional log files to rotate manually (handled by external logrotate, not native to auditd.conf).

path.description: Absolute path to the extra log file.
